svg.text: Sparse routing: each token goes to its top-2 experts

g.text: every token used only 2 of 8 experts — that’s the sparsity win

svg.text: Arrow thickness is the gate value, and the token’s output is the gate-weighted combine of just those two experts.
The amber meters are the running per-expert load: 12 dispatches (6 tokens × 2) spread unevenly over 8 experts — the load-balancing problem.
